hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Lingua and how it works.

free.a: Yes, completely. Lingua is free for all learners. No hidden subscription, no artificial limits. Our mission is to make language learning accessible to everyone.

languages.a: Lingua currently offers 9 languages: English, Spanish, German, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese and French. New languages are regularly added.

account.q: Do I need to create an account to use Lingua?
account.a: Yes, a free account is required to access AI conversations, save your vocabulary and track your progress.

howItWorks.q: How does the AI coach work?
howItWorks.a: The AI coach uses an advanced language model. You talk to it in your native language (French), and it replies in the language you're learning, correcting your mistakes and explaining grammar points along the way.

adaptsLevel.q: Does the AI adapt to my level?
adaptsLevel.a: Absolutely. The AI takes your declared level (beginner, intermediate, advanced) into account and automatically adjusts its complexity as you chat.

correctionsReliable.a: Corrections are generated by high-quality AI models and are very reliable for common grammar, conjugation and vocabulary mistakes. Like any automated tool, an occasional error is still possible.

privacy.a: Your conversations are stored securely and used only to improve your personal experience. We do not share your data with third parties.

autoVocabulary.a: In every conversation, the AI detects new or difficult words and automatically adds them to your personal vocabulary notebook, with translation and usage context.

streakXp.q: What do streak and XP mean?
streakXp.a: The streak is the number of consecutive days you've practiced. XP (experience points) are earned with every conversation and let you measure your overall progress.

offline.q: Can I view my vocabulary offline?
offline.a: The current version requires an internet connection. An offline version is planned for a future update.

editProfile.q: How do I edit my profile or change my target language?
editProfile.a: Go to your profile (icon at the bottom of the app) then tap Edit profile. There you can change your target language, your level and your personal information.

mobileApp.q: Is the app available on mobile?
mobileApp.a: Lingua works perfectly from a mobile browser. Native iOS and Android apps are currently in development.

contactSupport.a: Send us a message at support@lingua.app. We usually reply within 24 hours.

contact.heading: Couldn't find your answer?
contact.text: Our team is available to help you.
